lines.zh: 尾巴一弹，我已在十尺外。
lines.en: One snap of my tail and I am ten feet ahead.

lines.zh: 水流顺着我的背脊分开。
lines.en: The current splits along my spine.
I swim in a school; the formation holds.

lines.zh: 银色的肚子在光里一闪。
lines.en: My silver belly flashes in the light.
I swim fast; my gills never stop.
The fish ahead turns; so do I.

lines.zh: 我穿过冷水层，身上一紧。
lines.en: I cross a cold layer and my body tightens.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍水的声音像鼓点。
lines.en: My tail beats the water like a drum.
I swim along the outside of the school.
At speed, my head barely moves.
I round the reef without slowing.

lines.zh: 身后的水被我拉出一道线。
lines.en: I leave a line of disturbed water behind.
The whole school turns as one.

lines.zh: 我游一整天也不觉得累。
lines.en: I can swim all day without tiring.

lines.zh: 我们的队形像一个转动的银环。
lines.en: Our formation turns like a silver ring.

lines.zh: 我顶着水流往上，鳃张得更开。
lines.en: I push up against the current, gills wide.
I hang in the water, fins quivering.
The school spreads and closes again.
I wait for the one ahead to move first.
There is a faint taste of blood in the water.
My scales throw back a blue sheen.
I open and close my mouth, testing the current.
These waters are quiet today.
I tilt my body slightly.
Bait fish are jumping in the distance.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像一支搭好的箭。
lines.en: I hang there like a nocked arrow.
A schoolmate brushes my flank.
I am waiting for the tide to turn.

lines.zh: 阳光照进水里，成一条条。
lines.en: Sunlight comes down in stripes.
I make one lazy loop.
You are in the water, and not slow.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I turn my head and watch you with one eye.

lines.zh: 你身上的东西反光，很亮。
lines.en: The thing on you glints brightly.
Your legs kick like a frog's.

lines.zh: 你在船上，影子落进水里。
lines.en: You are on a boat; your shadow falls into the water.
I circle half way around you.
Your hand reaches down, too slowly.
I know what a net looks like.
You hold still; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你整张脸还圆。
lines.en: My eye is rounder than your whole face.
A scale comes off; red clouds the water.
I bolt and strike the reef.
That blow landed on my lateral line.
My gills work fast and ragged.
Pain pulls me out of the school.
I roll half over in the water.
One side of me begins to go numb.
I bite the water and endure it.
My tail still beats; I do not stop.
This gash will leave a scar.
You have fish in your hand; I smell it.
It is moving; it is still alive.
I come closer, just a little.
Lower the bait and I will rise.

lines.zh: 这不是我平时吃的东西。
lines.en: This is not what I usually eat.
I circle it first, to look.

lines.zh: 银色的东西最容易骗我。
lines.en: Silver things deceive me most easily.
The moment I open my mouth, it will be fast.
Do not let your hand shake, or I leave.
The water in the bucket is sloshing hard.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞一根鱼雷。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a torpedo.
I am covered in slippery scales.
My tail sweeps across your waist.
You cannot hold me; I am too fast.
I bump you once and run.
Do not stand in the school's path.
I deliberately took the force out of that one.
Step aside so the school can pass.
My lateral line felt you coming.
The splash hits you in the face.
One schoolmate has been following me.

lines.zh: 我们并排，尾巴一个节拍。
lines.en: Side by side, our tails beat one rhythm.
Its belly is brighter than mine.
We head for the warmer water.
The school parts to let us through.
We swim circles around each other.
The light in the water breaks into pieces.
It nuzzles my gill cover.

lines.zh: 卵会浮上去，被洋流带走。
lines.en: The eggs will rise and be carried off.
Next year the school will be bigger.
Something sinks; I go to look.
I take it in my mouth and let go.
It is not fish; I will not eat it.
A hook is hidden inside it.
I butt the floating thing aside.

lines.zh: 一片鳞从同伴身上掉了。
lines.en: A scale fell from a schoolmate.
I pick up seaweed and shake it.
This is too hard; it hurts my teeth.
A line is snagged on the reef.
I push it back into the sand.
The school suddenly tightens.

lines.zh: 有大的东西从下面上来。
lines.en: Something large rises from below.
The current has changed direction.
I see a grey shape.
The others begin crowding to one side.
That one eats fish.
I drop lower in the water.

lines.zh: 它比鱼群慢，却比鱼群大。
lines.en: It is slower than the school, but bigger.

lines.zh: 我听见牙齿合上的声音。
lines.en: I hear teeth close.
The school must scatter now.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的嘴，不是身子。
lines.en: I watch its mouth, not its body.
It turns, and the school breaks apart.
I look for a gap along its flank.
My tail is already coiled.
Just one more foot closer.
The blood taste in the water thickens.
It scattered three of my schoolmates.
I line up on it from below.

lines.zh: 它露出鳃边的一块软处。
lines.en: It shows a soft spot by the gills.
The instant it turns is all I need.
I ram its ribs; the water bursts.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，像一记鞭子。
lines.en: My tail lashes like a whip.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，撕了一下。
lines.en: I bite its fin and tear.

lines.zh: 它退了半尺，我又顶上去。
lines.en: It gives half a foot; I press in.

lines.zh: 这一撞用了整条身子的劲。
lines.en: That ram used my whole body.
We churn the water white.
A few of my scales are scraped off.
It snaps; I slip aside.
The school scatters behind us.
I can do that again.

lines.zh: 我从卵里挣出来，只有指节大。
lines.en: I break from the egg, the size of a knuckle.

lines.zh: 第一件事是跟着别的鱼游。
lines.en: The first thing I do is follow other fish.

lines.zh: 洋流把我推离了产卵地。
lines.en: The current pushes me from the spawning ground.

lines.zh: 我身上的条纹还没长出来。
lines.en: My stripes have not come in yet.
I hide in the shade of the kelp.

lines.zh: 水面上有光，我不敢上去。
lines.en: Light on the surface; I dare not rise.

lines.zh: 我和几百条同伴一起出发。
lines.en: I set out with hundreds of my kind.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，就认准方向。
lines.en: One tail beat and I know which way is forward.
This sea is colder than I expected.

lines.zh: 我长大了，桶就装不下了。
lines.en: When I grow, no bucket will hold me.

lines.zh: 水面烧起来，我只能往下钻。
lines.en: The surface burns; I can only dive.

lines.zh: 我拍在石头上，鳞溅了一地。
lines.en: I slap onto stone; scales scatter.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃贴在一起。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills stick together.
The blast throws me clear of the water.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎穿了我的背。
lines.en: Something sharp punches through my back.

lines.zh: 水忽然变甜，我的头很沉。
lines.en: The water turns sweet; my head grows heavy.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，我找不到饵鱼。
lines.en: The school is gone; I find no bait fish.

lines.zh: 水面炸亮，我整条鱼都僵了。
lines.en: The surface flashes; my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 没有水，我连转向都做不到。
lines.en: No water; I cannot even turn.
